---
title: "Explore Swimming Strokes"
subtitle: "Interactive exploration of Olympic swimming medalists (1980–2016)"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

df <- read_csv("data/olympics.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(
    sport == "Swimming",
    !is.na(height),
    !is.na(weight),
    !is.na(medal),
    year >= 1980
  ) |>
  mutate(
    stroke = case_when(
      str_detect(event, "Open Water") ~ "Open Water",
      str_detect(event, "Freestyle") ~ "Freestyle",
      str_detect(event, "Backstroke") ~ "Backstroke",
      str_detect(event, "Breaststroke") ~ "Breaststroke",
      str_detect(event, "Butterfly") ~ "Butterfly",
      str_detect(event, "Medley") ~ "Medley"
    ),
    bmi = round(weight / (height / 100)^2, 1),
    medal = factor(medal, levels = c("Gold", "Silver", "Bronze"))
  )
```

Hover over any point to inspect an athlete's height, weight, and Olympic event. Use the legend on the right to toggle strokes or double-click to isolate one stroke.

```{r}
#| label: interactive-scatter
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

p <- df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = height,
    y = weight,
    color = stroke,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", name, "</b> (", team, ")<br>",
      "Stroke: ", stroke, "<br>",
      "Event: ", event, "<br>",
      "Medal: ", medal, " (", year, " ", city, ")<br>",
      "Height: ", height, " cm | Weight: ", weight, " kg<br>",
      "BMI: ", bmi
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Height and Weight of Olympic Swimming Medalists (1980–2016)",
    x = "Height (cm)",
    y = "Weight (kg)",
    color = "Stroke"
  )

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
